rule.description: Match by Distinguished Name and Vault Name
rule.comment:
When a client attempts to create a new Identity object the Sentinel server performs internal matching using the Distinguished Name and Vault Name (and MSSP Customer ID, if needed).
Therefore, we need to attempt that match first, because if a matching object exists then attempting to create a new object will be in vain, because the Sentinel server will convert our add into a modify of the existing object.
(Note that MSSP Customer ID is added in the output transformation, if needed, so it is not necessary to specify it here in this rule.)
